cover.subline: They post updates. The ones building real influence publish carousels.

slides.title: Updates disappear.
slides.body: A text post lives in the feed for a few hours. Then the algorithm buries it. You gain almost nothing for the effort.

slides.title: Carousels compound.
slides.body: Multi-slide posts get 3x the dwell time. LinkedIn rewards dwell time. Your post keeps resurfacing for days.

slides.title: One idea per slide.
slides.body: The biggest mistake is cramming. Each slide should say one thing. Give the reader room to process.

slides.title: Start with the hook.
slides.body: Slide one has one job: stop the scroll. One bold sentence. One uncomfortable truth. Make them swipe.

takeaway.title: Carousels are compounding content.
takeaway.body: Every post builds on the last. Do this consistently and your profile stops being a resume. It becomes a brand.

cta.primary: Follow for more on LinkedIn content strategy.
